name: GGR SEO Audit – Website SEO Analyzer
author: Yogesh Kumar Raghav

sections.description:
GGR SEO Audit is a lightweight SEO audit and website analyzer plugin for WordPress that evaluates important on-page SEO signals and technical indicators.

The plugin reviews key SEO elements such as headings, metadata, links, content structure, and other optimization signals to help identify potential improvements.

It helps identify common on-page SEO issues and provides a quick overview of important optimization signals used in modern search engine optimization.

Audits are performed directly inside the WordPress admin dashboard using a simple interface without external APIs or third-party services.

The plugin is designed to support manual SEO analysis and site quality review rather than automated ranking manipulation.

What the plugin checks

It helps identify common on-page SEO issues and provides a quick overview of important optimization signals used in modern search engine optimization.

Audits are performed directly inside the WordPress admin dashboard using a simple interface without external APIs or third-party services.

The plugin is designed to support manual SEO analysis and site quality review rather than automated ranking manipulation.

What the plugin checks

  • Title tag presence
  • Meta description detection
  • Heading hierarchy (H1 – H4)
  • Content length indicators
  • Internal link detection
  • External link detection
  • Image ALT attributes
  • Canonical tag presence
  • Noindex detection
  • Structured data presence (JSON-LD)
  • Basic technical SEO signals

Features

  • Simple admin dashboard audit tool
  • On-demand page analysis
  • Clear SEO signal overview
  • Content structure checks
  • Internal & external link analysis
  • Image alt attribute detection
  • Canonical and noindex detection
  • Structured data presence check
  • AJAX-based audit processing
  • Lightweight and minimal overhead
  • No external API calls or tracking
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ggr-website-audit folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. In the WordPress dashboard, go to GGR Website Audit.
  4. Enter the page URL you want to analyze.
  5. Click Run Website Audit to generate the report.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin guarantee SEO rankings?

No. The plugin provides informational analysis of on-page SEO signals. Actual search rankings depend on many factors including competition, content quality, backlinks, and technical optimization.

Does the plugin collect or send data externally?

No. All analysis is performed locally within your WordPress installation. No external API requests or tracking services are used.

Can I audit any website?

The plugin is designed primarily to analyze pages from your own WordPress website.

Does the plugin modify themes or page styles?

No. The plugin does not modify theme files or override global styles.

Does this plugin store cookies?

For non-logged-in users, the plugin may set a temporary cookie to prevent repeated scan requests within a short time window. This cookie does not store personal information.
